feedback: The RM is well-formed and semantically faithful. Header: nonempty FINAL_STATES (u3), all states declared, u3 accepting and reachable via the ordered transitions u0→u1→u2→u3. Ordered transition coverage matches the task chain: has_door_key before door_open before target_picked_up, mirroring the environment's constraints (door cannot open without the key; box unreachable before door_open). The task 'Taking the key means you must open the door too' is correctly encoded: only the u1 branch on has_door_key progresses, and u1 waits for door_open; picking up the key while still in u0 moves to u1, obligating door_open before any box reward. Self-loops: every state has an else self-loop, so irrelevant/predicate-only events (key_lost never fires meaningfully here since door must be closed at that point... note key_lost can fire in u1; it is correctly ignored via the else self-loop) and regressions are covered by staying put; since the task does not require explicit regressions, no backward transitions are needed. door_open becoming false again (toggle shut) is handled: the agent remains in u2 waiting for the next door_open, which cannot be relocked, so progress is safe. Persistent/event distinction: key_lost (an event) is never used as a transition trigger, avoiding its one-step-only semantics; the condition propositions used (has_door_key, door_open, target_picked_up) are persistent, so missed-tick issues do not arise. target_picked_up is last-step-only but the episode terminates on pickup, so the u3 sink with else self-loop is never actually exercised beyond termination. Rewards: dense progress shaping (0.1, 0.3) bounded and strictly increasing to the terminal 1.0; no negative or unsafe rewards. Format matches the paper's REWARD_MACHINE schema exactly (STATES, INITIAL_STATE, FINAL_STATES, TRANSITION_FUNCTION with else, REWARD_FUNCTION keyed on (state, event, state)). One minor observation, not blocking: in u2, if the agent drops and re-picks nothing, else self-loop correctly keeps it waiting; the only box pickup both fires target_picked_up and ends the episode, so u3 acceptance coincides with task completion.
